#  Title:Quantum fields, strings, and physical mathematics
Authors:[Piotr Sułkowski](https://arxiv.org/search/hep-th?searchtype=author&query=Su%C5%82kowski,+P)
View a PDF of the paper titled Quantum fields, strings, and physical mathematics, by Piotr Su{\l}kowski
[View PDF](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2104.03350) [HTML (experimental)](https://arxiv.org/html/2104.03350v1)
> Abstract:I briefly review several important formal theory developments in quantum field theory and string theory that were reported at ICHEP conferences in past decades, and explain how they underlie a new research area referred to as physical or quantum mathematics. To illustrate these ideas in some specific context, I discuss certain aspects of topological string theory and a recently discovered knots-quivers correspondence.
